ctaDescription: We'll help you scope the right path — implementation, migration, or ongoing support — with a plan built around your systems and your team.

faqs.question: What's the difference between ECC and S/4HANA?
faqs.answer: S/4HANA is SAP's next-generation ERP suite built on an in-memory database. It offers real-time analytics, simplified data models, and a modern Fiori user interface compared to the legacy ECC platform.

faqs.question: How long does a typical SAP migration take?
faqs.answer: Timelines vary by scope, but a mid-size S/4HANA conversion typically runs 4-9 months from blueprint to go-live, with hypercare support afterward.

faqs.question: Do you support Brownfield, Greenfield, or Hybrid conversions?
faqs.answer: Yes — we assess your current landscape and recommend the conversion path that best balances cost, risk, and how much of your existing configuration you want to carry forward.

faqs.question: Can you integrate SAP with our existing CRM and finance systems?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. We build API and middleware integrations (SAP PI/PO, CPI) to connect SAP with the rest of your system landscape.

faqs.question: Do you offer ongoing support after go-live?
faqs.answer: Yes — our managed services cover 24/7 monitoring, patch management, performance tuning, and a functional/technical support desk.

faqs.question: How much does an SAP engagement cost?
faqs.answer: Cost depends on scope — a single module implementation looks very different from a full S/4HANA conversion. Book a free consultation and we'll scope a fit-for-purpose quote.
